name: Steppe Rock Outcrop
description: Low exposed bedrock shelf — Ukrainian steppe granite. Four-layer tapering granite stack (base slab→body→shelf→crest) with offset layers for organic irregular form; lichen/moss crown on crest and upper shelf; satellite pebble and dry-grass tufts at perimeter.

parts.name: Base slab — widest floor-contact granite layer
parts.note: 1200×80×800 mm; bevelBox CENTER-anchored so at.y = h/2 = 0.04 puts bottom at y=0.00 (floor)

parts.name: Main rock body — primary granite mass
parts.note: Sunk into base (bottom y=0.055) + offset +70 mm x, +30 mm z — deep overlap kills the clean step, reads as irregular bedrock

parts.name: Upper shelf ledge — differential-weathering step
parts.note: Sunk into body (bottom y=0.175) + offset −70 mm x, −50 mm z (leans opposite to body) — strong lateral jitter

parts.name: Crest — sub-rounded summit
parts.note: Sunk into shelf (bottom y=0.27) + offset +90 mm x, +50 mm z — irregular summit

parts.name: Lichen / bryophyte crust on crest top
parts.note: Caps crest top (y=0.35), following the offset summit. Opposite-normal stack — no z-fight

parts.name: Moss patch in upper shelf depression
parts.note: On the exposed shelf top (~y=0.285), set forward-left into the area the offset crest leaves uncovered

parts.name: Satellite pebble — eroded granite fragment
parts.note: Front-right of base; z_min=0.41 > base z_max=0.40 → no ground-plane z-fight with base

parts.name: Dry grass tuft at front-left rock margin
parts.note: z_min=0.41 > base z_max=0.40; x=[-0.40,-0.30] left of pebble → no y=0 z-fight with either

parts.name: Dry grass tuft at back-right rock margin
parts.note: z_max=-0.43 < base z_min=-0.40 → no ground-plane z-fight with base

needs: Precise measured plan and height dimensions for low (<0.5 m) Ukrainian Shield granite shelf outcrops — derivation relies on geomorphological class range only (Twidale & Vidal Romani 2005)
Crack / exfoliation joint stencil parts on body front/side faces — not modeled; sourced joint-spacing data needed first
